faq.answer1: Yes, all files are processed locally in your browser. Nothing is uploaded to our servers.
faq.question2: Do I need to install anything?
faq.answer2: No, PixProMax is a web-based tool. Just open it in your browser and start using it.
faq.answer3: Yes, after the first load, PixProMax can work offline with service workers.
